title: Vitamin Sea Home | KEY.co
description_expanded: As you ascend to the second floor, the heart of the home reveals itself in an open-concept living space. The kitchen, a modern culinary haven, is adorned with stainless steel appliances, stone countertops, a breakfast bar, and a spacious walk-in pantry. Adjacent, the living area invites relaxation with a 65” flat-screen TV, perfect for unwinding after a sun-kissed day. Step outside onto the private balcony, furnished with chairs, a table, and a sofa, offering a serene backdrop of Florida's lush landscapes and the mesmerizing Gulf sunset. The third floor is a retreat in itself, featuring two guest bedrooms, a loft space for additional relaxation, and a full bath with a tub/shower combo. Each morning can begin with a leisurely start on the balcony, absorbing the tranquil ambiance. The home's recent addition of a brand-new fence in the backyard makes it an ideal haven for pets. Whether seeking an escape for tranquility or a base for Gulf adventures, this home promises a blend of comfort, style, and unforgettable memories.
